say: One last thing, because a place you cannot find your way into is not yours either. Type a slash, then help, and everything you can do is laid out for you. The Help page takes it a step at a time: the first gestures, then the everyday words, then the rest, when you are ready. Type a slash, then tutorial, pick a course, and a bee flies it with you. That is the last idea, and it is the same as the first: this is a new way to be. So here is how to bee. The hive is yours.
